categories.main_business_segments: The company operates three main business segments: rolling (producing aluminum foil including LIB cathode current collectors and general-purpose foils), processing (manufacturing packaging materials such as retort pouches and industrial/architectural materials), and electronic parts sales (importing and selling Western Digital storage products).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include aluminum rolling and processing techniques focused on producing high-strength, thin aluminum foils for lithium-ion batteries and various packaging applications. The company emphasizes quality improvement, process optimization, and production efficiency, with R&D efforts on eco-friendly packaging materials and advanced aluminum foil products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include major battery manufacturers like LG Energy Solution, SK On, and Samsung SDI for aluminum foils used in lithium-ion batteries. The processing segment serves food, pharmaceutical, tobacco packaging industries, and industrial sectors such as automotive and construction. The electronic parts segment targets domestic retail and B2B customers through major Korean distributors and online/offline retailers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in South Korea with domestic manufacturing facilities located in Pyeongtaek. It exports aluminum foil products globally, including to the US and other international markets, while electronic parts sales are focused on the Korean domestic market.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream in the aluminum supply chain, producing aluminum foil and processed aluminum products from imported primary aluminum ingots. It is expanding vertical integration by constructing an aluminum casting plant to secure upstream raw material supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding production capacity for lithium-ion battery aluminum foils, enhancing product quality and eco-friendliness, and developing high-value-added aluminum products. R&D focuses on thin, high-strength foils for LIB applications and advanced packaging materials, supported by a dedicated technology research center.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of aluminum rolled and processed products to industrial customers and exports. The electronic parts segment earns revenue from importing and retailing Western Digital storage devices in Korea. Sales are mostly B2B with some B2C retail channels for electronic products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading aluminum foil producers in Korea, competing with Lotte Aluminum, Dongwon Systems, and others domestically, while facing increasing competition from large Chinese aluminum foil manufacturers. In electronic parts sales, it holds a strong position as the oldest and most comprehensive distributor of Western Digital products in Korea.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated sales of approximately 268 billion KRW, with assets of about 404 billion KRW and equity of 255 billion KRW. Despite a recent sales decline due to market conditions, the company has shown significant capital increases through third-party allotments and is investing heavily in capacity expansion to drive future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced aluminum foils tailored for lithium-ion batteries and specialized packaging applications, offering thin, high-strength, and eco-friendly materials. Its stable production system, direct customer relationships, and continuous innovation provide competitive advantages in both domestic and export markets.
